description: This file defines the ProductReviewDao interface, which extends the generic SalesManagerEntityDao for managing ProductReview entities and declares methods for retrieving product reviews based on customer, product, language, or both product and customer IDs.

classes.name: ProductReviewDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to product reviews, extending a generic DAO and providing methods for fetching reviews based on various criteria.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews associated with a particular customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews for a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews for a specific product filtered by language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a product review for a specific product and customer by their IDs.
